description: Publish an existing video from a transcribe or summarize job to YouTube. Creates a paid publish job (flat $1.75 price) and stores the OAuth token. Captions are auto-generated from the session transcript if available. Workflow: create_job → pay → poll get_job_status. The upload starts by itself once payment settles — there is no separate trigger step. Requires a YouTube OAuth2 access token obtained independently via Google OAuth (scope: youtube.upload).

access_token.description: YouTube OAuth2 access token — the caller is responsible for obtaining this via Google OAuth

refresh_token.description: YouTube OAuth2 refresh token — if provided, the Workflow will refresh the access token automatically before uploading

session_token.description: Session token from create_session, create_transcript, or create_summary

source_job_id.description: Job ID of an existing transcribe or summarize job in this session whose video to publish. The Workflow will auto-generate captions if no transcript is found.

name: publish_to_youtube
